numerical_integrator.applies_when: An independent, refinement-checked numerical reference can be built for the same differential equations and input schedule.

compressed_dynamics.applies_when: Semantic width is distinct from local dynamical width and full-width dynamics is the control.

end_to_end_system_win.memory_budget: Declare a target-platform budget including resident state and peak temporaries.

measurement_plan.report_confidence_intervals: 95% bootstrap interval over independent measurement blocks; document the resampling unit.

non_negotiable_rules: Operator correctness does not imply trajectory fidelity.
Trajectory fidelity does not imply held-out task quality.
A speedup in a kernel does not imply end-to-end system improvement.
Missing, duplicate, malformed, hash-mismatched or unpinned evidence fails closed.
No default promotion above 65536 dimensions follows from representability alone.
An unevaluated cell is unknown, not a pass and not a failure.
Approximate and analogue results remain separate from exact digital results.

external_research.use: Measurement-boundary and fixed-task/quality discipline; not a Symthaea result.

external_research.source: Hyperdimensional in-memory computing with analogue memristive crossbar arrays
external_research.use: Motivates a separate approximate/analogue evidence track; it is a different architecture and benchmark.

association_capacity_curve.query_scale_risk_model: P(any false match) <= min(1, M*p); M=N for one query against N records, M=N*(N-1)/2 for all-pairs comparisons.
hard_rules: Retain raw per-seed rows and explicit negative controls.
Choose thresholds on calibration data, evaluate on held-out comparisons, and report confidence bounds.
Zero false matches in a small Monte Carlo sample does not establish an extreme-tail guarantee.
Do not generalize the bipolar-f32 result to native uniform-f32 ContinuousHV or LTC/CfC dynamics.
Do not change the existing binding algebra implementation as part of this characterization example.

sample_limit.implication: Smoke-level distribution characterization only; threshold calibration and final held-out false-positive evaluation need separate samples. This sample cannot support extreme-tail guarantees.

next_architecture_controls: Two-stage retrieval: HDC shortlist K candidates from N, then separately measure a verifier; include shortlist misses and false candidates in end-to-end metrics.
Segmented/hierarchical memory to lower candidate comparisons rather than increasing D by default.
For all-pairs tasks, count N*(N-1)/2 comparisons in risk calculations.

paired_width_design.reason: Paired common prefixes isolate effect of adding coordinates from a change in codebook samples.

progressive_precision_routing.baseline: exhaustive highest-width reference on identical item IDs, queries, and held-out split
rules: Calibrate thresholds on a calibration split, freeze, then evaluate on distinct held-out data.
Low-D shortlist recall is a hard gate because the verifier cannot recover discarded candidates.
Support explicit abstain/refine decisions for ambiguous margins.
Count stored refinement data and index update cost; prefix sharing is not free.
All threshold targets are proposals and not measured results.

initial_corpus.storage_note: The experiment compares coordinate-evaluation work, not persistent index-memory savings. Full 16K records remain resident for both modes.

remaining_work: Run with multiple independent corpus seeds and calculate uncertainty intervals.
Add held-out correlated/near-duplicate and query-corruption controls.
Separate threshold calibration and final evaluation for an adaptive continue/refine/abstain policy.
Verify Rust formatting, compilation and runtime output on an equipped host.
